ds.title: Design system
ds.intro: Living reference for Cortex: the tokens, fonts, icons, components and brand, as the site renders them. Nothing is a mock-up. The site theme is changed in the header; the Colors section shows both palettes side by side.
ds.col.intro: Every token of `design/tokens.json`, in light and dark. The ratio is computed against the background of its pair (WCAG 2.2): 4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for a UI component, no threshold for a decorative rule. Dark is not an inversion of light.
ds.note.input: outline of a field on its card
ds.typo.intro: Inter for the interface, Hauora Sans for editorial headings, Source Serif 4 for long prose, Cascadia Code for code. Self-hosted fonts (SIL OFL 1.1).
ds.scale.h1.spec: Heading 1: 44 px, line height 1.15, Hauora Sans 600
ds.scale.h2.spec: Heading 2: 36 px, line height 1.15, Hauora Sans 600

ds.scale.detail.spec: Detail: 12 px, only for non-essential content
ds.scale.code.spec: Code and identifiers: Cascadia Code, 14 px
ds.prose.heading: Article prose (`.wiki`)
ds.prose.p1: Long prose is set in Source Serif 4, 18 px on desktop and 17 px on mobile, line height 1.7, across the full column width. An {link} is underlined and takes the link color{fn}, with some {code} in Cascadia Code.
ds.prose.li1: Bullets stay simple, with no decorative extras.
ds.prose.li2: Headings and callout titles are Hauora Sans; tables keep the interface Inter.
ds.prose.ol2: Second step, which contains a bit more text to show the line wrapping and the alignment of the number.
ds.prose.quote: A quotation stands out with a 3 px rule and secondary text, with no background or rounded frame.
ds.prose.noteBody: A note from the owner: yellow paper background, 4 px rule on the left, Hauora Sans title.
ds.prose.warnBody: A reservation about the reliability of a page: rust background, same structure as the note.
ds.prose.footnote: A footnote, the target of the reference above. {back}
ds.shapes.intro: Radius 0 everywhere, 1 px borders, no shadow on page surfaces. They are told apart by background, outline and stacking order; only floating layers carry a shadow (see below). Only symbols keep the curve that makes them recognizable.
ds.shapes.float.p1: Flat does not mean absolutely flat: two discreet levels of relief. The layers that float above the page (menus, popovers, the search palette, notifications, the assistant's modal drawer) take the `--popover` background, a 1 px outline in `--input` (sharper than `--border`) and the `--shadow-overlay` shadow, denser in dark. The page surfaces (cards, home sections, article side panels) keep their `--border` outline and a simple relief, `--shadow-surface`: a one-pixel shadow, never a floating card. The menu in the Components section applies the layer shadow when it opens.
ds.shapes.float.p2: Docked assistant panel: it does not float, but a shadow on its left edge (`--shadow-edge`) and an `--input` outline set it apart from the page; its width is adjusted with the handle on its edge. Scrollbars: a single global rule, `scrollbar-width: thin` and a muted-ink thumb on a transparent track (`--scrollbar-thumb`, sharper on hover), for the page as for every scrolling area; they always stay visible.
ds.focus.heading: Focus ring
ds.icons.intro: {count} icons from Phosphor Icons, Light weight (256 grid, filled shapes in `currentColor`, no stroke), mapped to Cortex names in `design/icons.json`. Each instance is a `<use>` of the page sprite. Sizes 16, 20 and 24 px.
ds.icons.star: `star` with `filled` draws `star-filled` (Fill weight): reserved for the active star of favorites.
ds.typo.credit: Inter (Latin subsets) and Hauora Sans: SIL Open Font License 1.1.
ds.comp.intro: Primitives from `ui/` and Cortex components. The “focus” cells reproduce the ring without moving the focus; “invalid” sets `aria-invalid`.

ds.brand.intro: The brain graph: a brain in profile, facing right, drawn as a knowledge graph. Small square nodes joined by straight links, whose outer links form the outline; the prefrontal group, at the front, takes the accent color. A single SVG drawing, never an image, in three optical sizes (48, 24 and 16). The colors come from the tokens.
ds.brand.home: Home: 72 px mark, wordmark at heading 1 size
ds.avatar.heading: Assistant avatar
ds.avatar.states: `idle`: still. `pending`: an ochre dot (`--signal`), surrounded by a light halo, wanders at random along the inner links of the brain; still at the middle of a link with reduced motion and below 24 px. `answer`: the nodes of the prefrontal group grow once, then stay larger. `error`: a link of the prefrontal group is broken, the break marked by a dot in the destructive color.
ds.avatar.reducedMotion: With `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, nothing moves: each state is a distinct fixed composition (while pending, the signal stays halfway). The animation never carries the information alone, the status text stays in the panel.
ds.avatar.systemReduce: Your system currently requests: reduced motion.
ds.avatar.systemAllow: Your system currently requests: animations allowed.
ds.activity.heading: Activity indicator
ds.activity.desc: Three small squares in the `--primary` color, one lit at a time, the light stepping from left to right (1.2 s cycle, no easing). Shown while the assistant waits, and beside text that is arriving. It is sized in pixels (18 px by default) and sits inline. With `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` it stays still, the three squares equally dim. Decorative: the status text says what is going on.
